pull.title: payments: persist Stripe settlement identity
pull.body:
## Summary
- persist Stripe settlement purpose and business reference in `payment_transactions`
- backfill existing job-publication transactions from `job_publications`, treating remaining historical rows as top-ups
- bind idempotent duplicate validation to user, amount, currency, settlement purpose and business reference
- keep migrated legacy top-ups without a stored request reference retry-safe
- add regressions for cross-purpose and cross-publication PaymentIntent replay

## Why
A Stripe PaymentIntent claim was previously auditable only by user/amount/currency. Because Stripe metadata is mutable, a previously claimed intent could be replayed through another commercial settlement path and pass duplicate recognition. Persisting the business settlement identity closes that ambiguity and makes the payment ledger commercially auditable.

## Migration
Adds Flyway `V41__payment_settlement_identity.sql` with a constrained `settlement_purpose` and indexed `business_reference`.

## Validation
CI is required before merge. This PR must not merge while latest-head checks are pending or failing.

issue.title: payments: reconcile Stripe settlement identity
issue.body:
## Summary
- extend finance reconciliation so Stripe ledger health includes persisted settlement purpose/business-reference integrity
- require `JOB_PUBLICATION` claims to remain bound to the matching `job_publications` row and reject top-up claims that are attached to publication PaymentIntents
- extend payments-ledger smoke with a deliberate settlement-identity corruption and recovery check
- document the new reconciliation invariant

## Why
PR #101 made Stripe settlement identity durable in `payment_transactions`. The finance health check still validated only wallet/amount/currency correspondence, so a corrupted or manually altered purpose/reference could remain invisible operationally. This slice makes that commercial identity part of reconciliation.

## Migration
No new Flyway migration. Uses the V41 columns merged in #101.

## Validation
Latest-head CI/checks must be green before merge; do not merge while pending or failing.
